title: Saudi attack on Hodeida reportedly kills four and wounds 18
detail: Middle East Eye live blog reports a Saudi attack on Yemen's Hodeida killed four people and wounded 18. Based on the headline only; target, weapon and casualty details are not independently confirmed.

title: Yemeni government says civilians killed and injured in Houthi attack in Lahij
detail: Middle East Eye live blog relays a statement by the Saudi-backed Yemeni government that civilians were killed and injured in a Houthi attack in Lahij governorate. Based on the headline only; casualty numbers and weapon are not confirmed.

title: Houthis say Saudi attack kills 17
detail: Houthi-side claim, reported via Google News aggregation, that a Saudi attack killed 17 people. Unverified; may relate to the earlier Hodeida report, which gave different casualty figures.
